title: Austin Housing Fund Budget Approved
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors held a brief meeting.
*   The board unanimously approved its 1992-93 budget, outlining financial plans for local housing initiatives.
*   All items, including the approval of previous meeting minutes, passed unanimously in the three-minute session.

MINUTES OF THE
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
September 17, 1992
The meeting was called to order at 3:52 p.a. by Board Member Dr. Charles Urdy Present:
Charles Urdy, Ronney Reynolds, Bob Larson, Max Nofziger, Gus Garcia, and Louise Epstein
Absent: Bruce Todd
Agenda Item No. One:
Approve Minutes of September 3, 1992 meeting. Motion The Board, on Board Member Garcia's
motion and Board Member Nofziger's second, approved the minutes on a 6-0-0 vote with Board
Member Todd absent. ---
Agenda Item No. Two:
Approve a resolution authorizing 1992-93 budget for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation
(Recommended by AHFC Review Committee 2-0)
Motion /
The Board, on Board Member Garcia's motion and Board Member Larson's second, approved the
resolution on a 6-0-0 vote with Board Member Todd absent.
The meeting was adjourned at 3:55 p.m.
